sprints.title: Registry Alignment and Certification Slice
sprints.objective: Align D1 provider/dataset identities and 5m granularity with the certified D3 sources, reconcile conflicting operational summaries read-only, and populate or verify the six-instrument 2026-07-11 certification slice.
sprints.completionGate: Registry bindings are explicit; one persisted reconciliation is authoritative; the certification slice has canonical, lineage, Coverage, and publication-state evidence.

sprints.title: Bounded Recent Corpus Population
sprints.objective: Populate and reconcile the frozen 90-day OHLCV/OI/Funding core and capacity-approved 14-day AggTrades window for six instruments.
sprints.completionGate: All corpus partitions are classified; common Coverage windows and lineage reconcile.

sprints.title: Minimal D4 Evidence Activation
sprints.objective: Define versioned minimum market-state and event Evidence rules with explicit component availability and counter-evidence.
sprints.completionGate: Real Consistency Results and Evidence Packets are reproducible for current state and selected events; missing mandatory facts suppress Confidence.

sprints.title: Consumer Projection Runtime
sprints.objective: Implement the six page projections and three shared read models with cache, Event Time, Knowledge Time, version, lineage, stale, and no-data semantics.
sprints.completionGate: All nine projection/read-model contract tests and real-data reads pass for all six page consumers.

sprints.title: Functional Page Cutover
sprints.objective: Replace primary legacy reads with governed projections while preserving protected realtime responsiveness and graceful degradation.
sprints.completionGate: Every primary feature meets its matrix requirement and no governed feature silently falls back to legacy data.

sprints.title: Coinalyze Aggregated Liquidation Migration
sprints.objective: Bring the mapping-gated BTC five-minute aggregated bars through D3 with explicit EXPERIMENTAL and LOWER_BOUND semantics.
sprints.completionGate: Real Canary and rerun pass with bounded Coverage and no claim of individual-event completeness.

sprints.title: Historical Order-Flow Corpus
sprints.objective: Certify a bounded snapshot-capable historical depth source or a clearly limited update-flow Segment and read port.
sprints.completionGate: Selected event windows replay without request-time reconstruction and expose exact limitation status.

sprints.title: Demo Evidence Corpus
sprints.objective: Verify and populate four to six cross-dataset event windows, then freeze their Evidence identities and source sizes.
sprints.completionGate: Each selected event has complete mandatory overlap, authoritative annotation, reproducible Evidence, and explicit limitations.

sprints.title: Data Sufficiency and Cross-Page QA
sprints.objective: Test missing, stale, gap, and partial windows plus instrument/time/candidate/evidence state across navigation.
sprints.completionGate: All completion-gate assertions pass; no primary unexplained blank, fake Confidence, zero-fill, or timestamp disagreement remains.

sprints.title: UI and Demo Polish
sprints.objective: Polish status visibility, responsive layouts, event navigation, and demo packaging after functional truth is stable.
sprints.completionGate: Six-page demo walkthrough succeeds using only governed real data and disclosed limitations.

sprints.title: Full Historical Expansion
sprints.objective: Resume full histories and Phase V certification after capacity expansion.
